summary: Sharan Hegde is a high-profile Indian finance influencer and entrepreneur, best known as the founder of 1% Club and the creator behind the 'Finance With Sharan' brand. With over 1 crore followers across platforms, he has transitioned from a management consulting background (PwC, KPMG) to building a SEBI-licensed wealth platform. He is currently focused on launching an AI-first personal finance app and managing over ₹750 Crore in assets under advisory. His public persona is built on financial education, transparency ('build in public'), and a narrative of overcoming early academic setbacks (IIT rejection) to achieve significant business success without outside investment.
